title: Quick Indian Rice Milk Pudding (Kheer)
description: A light and creamy Indian rice pudding made with green curry paste, perfect for a quick and easy dessert. This recipe is inspired by the traditional South Indian dish from the Udupi region.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, green curry paste, sugar, and salt. Heat over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is coated in the milk mixture.
Transfer the saucepan to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the mixture is creamy.
Remove the saucepan from the oven and stir in the ghee or unsalted butter and cardamom powder.
Let the kheer cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the kheer chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
